about.story1: QIT is a Quran academy based in Khanpur, Dera Ghazi Khan, Punjab, Pakistan, teaching students online across the world and in person at our Khanpur campus. Our mission is simple: build a Quranic nation — one student at a time — by making authentic, one-to-one Quran education easy to reach for every family.
about.story2: Whether a four-year-old is learning the Arabic alphabet, a mother is perfecting her Tajweed with a female teacher, or a student is working towards Ijazah, every QIT student follows a clear pathway with a personal teacher, a study plan, and progress that parents can see.

legal.note: This page is a placeholder. The final policy text will be published here before enrolment opens.

privacyBody.rest: QIT — Quran Information Technology ("QIT", "we") respects your privacy. This page explains, in brief, how we handle the information you share with us through this website.

When you submit the free-trial form, you share the student's name, age, gender, chosen course, country/time zone, WhatsApp number, optional email, preferred class times and teacher preference. The form opens WhatsApp with these details prefilled — the enquiry is sent by you, through WhatsApp.
Only to arrange your trial class, plan lessons and contact you about your studies. We do not sell your information.
You may ask us at any time, on WhatsApp, what information we hold about you and ask for it to be corrected or deleted.

legal.privacyDesc: Privacy Policy of QIT — Quran Information Technology, Khanpur, Dera Ghazi Khan.

refundBody.rest: This page sets out how QIT — Quran Information Technology handles pauses, cancellations, missed classes and refunds. It matches the billing notes on our Pricing page.
The free trial class is completely free — no payment details are taken, so there is nothing to refund.

You may pause or cancel your monthly plan by informing us on WhatsApp. The exact notice period and any refund of unused classes will be confirmed in the final policy published here before enrolment opens.

If you inform us in advance that you cannot attend, we will arrange a makeup class according to the makeup policy. If your teacher is ever unavailable, a substitute teacher or a rescheduled class will be offered.
For anything about fees or refunds, message us on WhatsApp and we will answer honestly and in writing.

legal.refundDesc: Refund, pause and missed-class policy of QIT — Quran Information Technology.

termsBody.rest: These brief terms apply to classes provided by QIT — Quran Information Technology ("QIT"), online and on-campus in Khanpur, Dera Ghazi Khan.
Online classes are live and one-to-one at the times agreed with each student. Students should join on time and let us know as early as possible if they cannot attend.
Fees are paid monthly in advance according to the plan chosen on the Pricing page. Exact fee amounts are confirmed in writing at enrolment.
Students and teachers treat each other with respect at all times. Parents may sit in on children's online classes.
We may update these terms; the version published on this page is the current one.
